description_en: Associates a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a transit router (TR) with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）关联专有网络（VPC）或者转发路由器（TR）
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter create-express-connect-router-association --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --association-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExpressConnectRouterAssociation

parameters.help_en: The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The region to which the associated resource belongs
parameters.name: association_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the account that owns the transit router instance. Default value: the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the current logon account.

This parameter is required if you want to load a cross-account network instance
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。默认值为当前登录的阿里云账号ID。

如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: transit_router_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the transit router.
The TransitRouterId and VpcId parameters are mutually exclusive, and one of them must be specified. Create a transit router by calling the CreateTransitRouter API of the Cbn(2017-09-12) product and obtain the TransitRouterId
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器ID。
TransitRouterId和VpcId参数二者互斥且必须提供其一。需先通过 Cbn(2017-09-12) 产品的CreateTransitRouter API 创建转发路由器并获取TransitRouterId
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en:
The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID.
CenId is required when TransitRouterId is specified. Create a CEN instance by calling the CreateCen API of the Cbn(2017-09-12) product and obtain the CenId
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例ID。
指定 TransitRouterId 时 CenId 为必填，需先通过 Cbn(2017-09-12) 产品的 CreateCen创建 CEN实例并获取 CenId
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the account that owns the VPC-connected instance. Default value: the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the current logon account.

This parameter is required if you want to load a cross-account network instance
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。默认为当前登录的阿里云账号ID。

如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: vpc_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The VPC-connected instance ID.
The VpcId and TransitRouterId parameters are mutually exclusive, and one of them must be specified.
Create a VPC by calling the CreateVpc API of the Vpc(2016-04-28) product and obtain the VpcId
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例ID。
VpcId 和 TransitRouterId 参数二者互斥且必须提供其一。
需先通过 Vpc(2016-04-28) 产品的 CreateVpc API 创建 VPC 并获取 VpcId
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The list of allowed prefix routes
parameters.name: allowed_prefixes

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to initiate the association when the ECR is associated with a TR. Valid values:

true: The association does not need to be initiated from the transit router side.
false: The association needs to be initiated from the transit router side
parameters.help_zh:
ECR绑定TR时是否发起关联。取值：

true：不需要在转发路由器侧发起关联。
false：需要在转发路由器侧发起关联
parameters.name: create_attachment

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether this is a dry run request. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without modifying EPS resources.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The prefix route mode. Valid values:
MatchMode: match mode. Only the configured route CIDR blocks are advertised to the IDC, and previously advertised specific routes are withdrawn.
IncrementalMode: incremental mode. The configured route CIDR blocks are advertised to the IDC, and previously advertised specific routes that fall within the configured CIDR blocks are withdrawn. Specific routes that do not fall within the configured CIDR blocks remain advertised
parameters.help_zh:
前缀路由模式，取值：
MatchMode: 匹配模式, 仅发布配置的路由网段到IDC，对原有发布的明细路由进行回撤。
IncrementalMode: 增量模式, 发布配置的路由网段到IDC的同时对原有发布落在配置的路由网段内的明细路由进行回撤，未落在配置的网段内的明细路由保持发布
parameters.name: allowed_prefixes_mode

parameters.help_en: The description of the associated resource. The description must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 关联资源的描述信息。长度为0～128个字符
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The tag key of the resource. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the resource. The tag value can be an empty string and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签值。可以为空字符串，最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

You can bind up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

最多可以绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

AssociationId.description_en: The associate ID between the Express Connect Router (ECR) and the VPC or TR

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the association was successful. Other values indicate failure. For more information, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the `%s` in the ErrMessage return parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.
False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
